citation.journal: Journal of Alternative and Complementary Medicine

cited_by.title: Bush teas and herbal remedies (cerasee, bitter leaf) with medicines

record.population: Patients aged 12 and over with uncomplicated malaria, a traditional remedy trial in Africa
record.design: Uncontrolled clinical trial of an infusion of fresh Vernonia amygdalina (bitter leaf)
record.finding: An adequate clinical response at day 14 occurred in 67% of cases, but complete parasite clearance occurred in only 32% of those, and 71% of those had recrudescence. No significant side effects or toxicity were seen. The authors say more studies are needed.
record.note: Uncontrolled, in malaria; it says nothing about blood sugar. Not evidence that bitter leaf works.
